title: Gangtok & Nathula Pass Classic
highlights: Nathula Pass Indo-China Border at 14,140 ft
Gangtok viewpoints: Hanuman Tok, Tashi & Ganesh Tok
Evening leisure walks on MG Marg

days.label: Day 1
days.title: NJP / IXB to Gangtok - Hill Drive & MG Marg
days.text: Pickup from NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport (IXB). Enjoy a 4-5 hour scenic drive along the Teesta River to Gangtok. Check into your hotel and spend the evening soaking in the mountain atmosphere on MG Marg.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Nathula Pass, Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir Excursion
days.text: Early morning drive to the Indo-China border at Nathula Pass (14,140 ft). Explore the sacred glacial Tsomgo (Changu) Lake and visit the revered Baba Harbhajan Singh Memorial Temple with permits pre-arranged.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Gangtok Full Day Sightseeing & Culture Tour
days.text: Comprehensive city sightseeing visiting Hanuman Tok, Ganesh Tok, Tashi Viewpoint, Bakthang Waterfalls, Do-Drul Chorten, Gonjang Monastery, the Flower Exhibition Centre, and the Gangtok Ropeway ride.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Gangtok to NJP / IXB Departure
days.text: Breakfast with valley views, followed by your transfer back to NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport with cherished memories of Sikkim.

included: Private cab (Innova / Xylo / Scorpio) for all 4 days
Nathula Pass & East Sikkim restricted area permits
